name: Analyze
desc: Read a monster's chart and its temper. Wardens and bosses refuse.

name: HP Leech
desc: Bites and drinks. It heals by as much as it takes.

name: MP Leech
desc: Drinks a foe's MP into its own pool.

name: Lunge
desc: All your weight behind one blow.

name: Sweep
desc: A wide cut through two or three of them.

name: Rampage
desc: Through the whole line and back again.

name: Rend
desc: A blow meant to open something up.

name: Scything Arc
desc: One long stroke, two or three of them in its way.

name: Onslaught
desc: Everything standing, one after another, without a breath.

name: Deathblow
desc: One monster, one blow, and no second needed.

name: Carnage
desc: Two or three of them, and nothing tidy about it.

name: Warpath
desc: The whole room, cut down to the last.

name: Ember
desc: A flame set on one monster.

name: Cinderfall
desc: Embers fall across two or three of them.

name: Pyre
desc: The whole room catches.

name: Blaze
desc: A flame that does not go out until it has finished.

name: Firestorm
desc: Wind and fire together, over two or three.

name: Inferno
desc: The air itself burns, wall to wall.

name: Immolate
desc: One monster, and nothing left of it to bury.

name: Ashfall
desc: Two or three of them go up and come down as ash.

name: Worldfire
desc: Everything standing, all at once, down to the stone.

name: Rime
desc: Frost closes over one monster.

name: Hailfall
desc: Hail comes down on two or three of them.

name: Whiteout
desc: Everything in the room goes cold at once.

name: Frostbite
desc: The cold gets into one monster and stays.

name: Blizzard
desc: A wind full of ice, across two or three.

name: Deep Winter
desc: Winter arrives in the room and does not leave.

name: Glaciate
desc: One monster, taken down to still.

name: Shardfall
desc: Ice falls in pieces on two or three of them.

name: Killing Frost
desc: The whole room stops moving together.

name: Arc
desc: Current jumps to one monster.

name: Forkfall
desc: The current forks into two or three of them.

name: Thunderhead
desc: It breaks over all of them together.

name: Bolt
desc: One line of it, straight through one monster.

name: Thunderstorm
desc: It keeps finding two or three of them.

name: Tempest
desc: The room becomes weather.

name: Levin
desc: White fire, and one monster in the way of it.

name: Skyfall
desc: It comes down on two or three at once.

name: Stormcrown
desc: Everything standing is standing under it.

name: Banish
desc: Tries to expel one monster outright. Some things cannot abide the light.

name: Winnow
desc: Reaches for two or three at once, and holds each of them less firmly.

name: Daybreak
desc: Opens the light on every monster standing. Thin, across that many.

name: Exile
desc: A firmer hand on one monster than Banish can manage.

name: Scour
desc: Two or three of them, and it does not let go as easily.

name: Zenith
desc: Light from directly overhead, on all of them.

name: Absolve
desc: One monster, and very little argument about it.

name: Sunburst
desc: Two or three caught in the open at once.

name: White Hour
desc: Nowhere in the room is dark enough to stand in.

name: Consign
desc: Tries to unmake one monster outright. Some things cannot abide the dark.

name: Cull
desc: Takes two or three together, and takes each of them less surely.

name: Nightfall
desc: Closes the dark over the whole room. Thin, across that many.

name: Erase
desc: One monster, and a better chance there is nothing left.

name: Reap
desc: Two or three of them, cut down in one pass.

name: Eclipse
desc: The light goes out on all of them at once.

name: Unmake
desc: One monster, and very little of it survives the asking.

name: Harvest
desc: Two or three taken together and not given back.

name: Long Night
desc: The dark closes over everything standing and stays closed.

name: Cure
desc: Restores 30 HP to one of you.

name: Cura
desc: Restores 80 HP to one of you.

name: Curaga
desc: Fully restores one of you.

name: Cure All
desc: Restores 25 HP to the whole party.

name: Cura All
desc: Restores 65 HP to the whole party.

name: Curaga All
desc: Fully restores the whole party.

name: Whet
desc: Sharpens the party's attacks.

name: Ward
desc: Hardens the party's guard.

name: Quicken
desc: Quickens the party — lands and dodges more.

name: Stoke
desc: Feeds the party's magic — stronger spells and heals.

name: Blunt
desc: Dulls every enemy's attacks.

name: Sunder
desc: Breaks every enemy's guard.

name: Mire
desc: Slows every enemy — they miss more.

name: Damp
desc: Smothers every enemy's magic.

name: Purge
desc: Strips the other side of everything it has raised.

name: Steady
desc: Clears every penalty stacked on your own side.

name: Venom
desc: Poisons the enemy.

name: Shock
desc: Paralyzes the enemy.

name: Mute
desc: Silences the enemy.

name: Bind
desc: Immobilizes the enemy.
